_about: The six classes (SPEC.md › Classes). Numbers that a GM tunes live in balance.json under `classes`; this file holds the structure: ids, names, class stat, crest mark, starting weapon, passive/active/upgrade descriptions and the effect keys the code switches on.

passive.text: Weapon stakes cost 25% less; hits deal 15% more

active.name: Double Down
active.text: The next hit deals double damage, win or lose the stake

upgrades.text: Double Down also doubles a spell's healing
Can use an item whose stake exceeds Health, dropping to 1

passive.text: Healing items restore 50% more; Blood Pacts cost 15%; takes 10% less from monsters

active.name: House Rules
active.text: Cancel the next Chaos effect, or turn the next roll against you into a push

upgrades.text: House Rules can void an enemy win once per fight

passive.text: Fork and Nudge cost half; reads every letter that crosses their tile; one free Smoke Bomb per run

active.name: Sleight
active.text: Swap tiles with any player, or steal the item in a random grid cell of a player in reach

upgrades.text: Hidden on the TV map for 2 turns after a Smoke Bomb

passive.text: +25% damage against players; death penalty one turn shorter; cannot be swapped

active.name: Call Out
active.text: Force a fight with any player within 3 tiles; they cannot Smoke Bomb out

upgrades.text: Call Out reaches the whole region

passive.text: Pets earn Power 2x; extra egg at run start; first pet faint per run is undone

active.name: Rally
active.text: Heal the active pet to full mid-fight

upgrades.text: Two pets fight before you do

passive.text: Spells stake 50% less; one free Reroll per fight

active.name: Rig the Deck
active.text: Pick the result of the next binary outcome (any 50/50, over/under, red/black) for anyone in the fight

upgrades.text: Reroll works on an opponent's roll
Rig the Deck works on a wheel
